claims: A two-hour delay means school, work, or transport services start 120 minutes later than their regularly scheduled time.
Bus pickups, classes, and morning programs typically operate exactly two hours later than normal.
In a 2-hour delay, if school usually starts at 8:00 a.m., it will start at 10:00 a.m.
In a 2-hour delay, morning bus pickups are delayed by two hours.
In a 2-hour delay, a 7:10 a.m. bus pickup becomes 9:10 a.m.
